Want to become an AI Engineer in 2026? Stop learning only AI theory and start understanding how real world AI applications are built!

Welcome to AI Engineering Masterclass Part 2, where we explore practical AI engineering concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Knowledge Bases, Context Windows, and AI Agents. This session focuses on understanding how modern AI systems work and how these technologies connect to build intelligent AI-powered applications.

Understanding LLMs and AI Engineering

AI Engineering is more than just using ChatGPT or writing prompts. It involves understanding how Large Language Models work, how they process information, and how developers integrate them into real-world applications. In this masterclass, we'll explore important AI engineering concepts and practical approaches to building LLM-powered systems.

Context Window and Context Engineering

Why do AI models sometimes forget earlier conversations? How do context windows and token limits affect AI applications? We'll explore context window implementation, token management, and context engineering techniques that help developers design more reliable and efficient AI systems.

RAG Problems and Practical Solutions

Traditional RAG systems can struggle with retrieval accuracy, irrelevant information, and hallucinations. In this session, we'll discuss common RAG challenges, why retrieval pipelines sometimes fail, and techniques that can improve knowledge retrieval and answer quality.

AI Knowledge Base and Knowledge Management

A well-designed knowledge base helps AI applications work with relevant information beyond their training data. We'll explore how AI knowledge systems connect documents, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval workflows to support more useful and context-aware responses.

From LLM Applications to AI Agents

Discover the concepts behind AI Agents and how they extend traditional LLM applications with tools, workflows, and decision-making capabilities. Understand how context management, knowledge retrieval, and AI automation contribute to building more capable AI-powered systems.

Who Should Watch This Masterclass?

Whether you're a Python developer, software engineer, AI enthusiast, student, automation developer, or aspiring AI Engineer, this session will help you strengthen your understanding of practical Generative AI engineering.

 Learn AI. Build AI. Become an AI Engineer!

Watch the complete masterclass, experiment with the concepts, and continue building your AI engineering skills.

videos.title: And You'll Never Let Anyone Stress You Out Again | Mel Robbins
videos.description:
Saying "let it go" makes you feel like you lost. Saying "let them" makes you feel like you rose above it.

In this clip, Mel Robbins and Jay Shetty talk about the Let Them theory. It starts with a rude boss and a pile of dishes in the sink. But Mel says that's only half of it.

She shares the talk Chris had with her about cardboard boxes and a messy counter. One sentence from him changed how she heard it. She explains why you can't change another person, and what you can do instead. And she gives a 30-day rule for after a breakup.

Learn about the second part of the theory that people never tattoo on themselves. And learn why a simple apology can help someone you love want to change.
